::: {.callout-note}

Basado en la visualización diseñada por Kristoffer Magnusson: [*Interpreting Correlations: An interactive visualization*](https://rpsychologist.com/correlation/)

:::








```{=html}
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;600&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root {
  --bg: #f6f8fa;
  --card: #ffffff;
  --card-inset: #f1f4f8;
  --border: #d8dee4;
  --text: #1f2328;
  --muted: #59636e;
  --blue: #2f6fd0;
  --orange: #d9822b;
  --green: #1a7f4b;
  --red: #cf222e;
  --line: #c0392b;
  --grid: #e6e9ed;
}
body { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); }
.quarto-title-block .quarto-title-banner, header#title-block-header { background: transparent; }
.quarto-title p.subtitle { color: var(--muted); }

.card-panel {
  background: var(--card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 1.25rem 1.25rem 1rem;
  height: 100%;
}
.card-panel h3 {
  font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; margin: 0 0 0.25rem; border: none;
}
.card-panel .card-sub { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.85rem; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }

/* Barra de controles */
.controls { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-end; gap: 1.5rem; }
.control-group label.group-label { font-weight: 700; display: block; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; }
.control-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; }
.control-row input[type=number] {
  width: 95px; background: var(--card-inset); color: var(--text);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.cases { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; margin-top: 1rem; }
.cases .cases-label { color: var(--muted); margin-right: 0.25rem; }
.btn-case, .btn-plain {
  background: var(--card-inset); color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace; font-size: 0.85rem;
}
.btn-case:hover, .btn-plain:hover { border-color: var(--blue); color: var(--text); background: var(--card-inset); }

/* Sliders nativos: el valor va en el campo numérico */
.control-row input[type=range] { width: 240px; max-width: 100%; accent-color: var(--blue); }

/* Tarjeta de resultados */
.verdict {
  font-size: 1.9rem; font-weight: 700; padding-left: 0.9rem;
  border-left: 5px solid; margin: 0.25rem 0 0.75rem;
}
.stats-table { width: 100%; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.stats-table td { padding: 0.2rem 0; vertical-align: top; }
.stats-table td:first-child { color: var(--muted); width: 55%; }
.stats-table td:last-child { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace; font-weight: 600; }
.explanation { margin-bottom: 1.25rem; }
.venn-caption { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.85rem; }

/* Gráficos SVG */
.plot svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; }
#scatter_plot svg { max-height: 470px; }
#venn_plot svg { max-height: 170px; }
.plot .tick { fill: var(--muted); font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace; font-size: 13px; }
.plot .axis-title { font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; }
</style>

<div class="card-panel" style="margin-bottom: 1.25rem; height: auto;">
  <div class="controls">
    <div class="control-group">
      <label class="group-label" for="r_num">Correlación r</label>
      <div class="control-row">
        <input type="range" id="r_slider" min="-0.99" max="0.99" step="0.01" value="0.51" aria-label="Correlación r">
        <input type="number" id="r_num" class="form-control" min="-0.99" max="0.99" step="0.01" value="0.51">
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="control-group">
      <label class="group-label" for="n_num">Tamaño muestral n</label>
      <div class="control-row">
        <input type="range" id="n_slider" min="4" max="1000" step="1" value="30" aria-label="Tamaño muestral n">
        <input type="number" id="n_num" class="form-control" min="4" max="1000" step="1" value="30">
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="control-row" style="padding-bottom: 0.4rem;">
      <button type="button" class="btn btn-plain" id="resample">Nueva muestra</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="cases" id="cases">
    <span class="cases-label">Casos para la clase:</span>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="grid">
  <div class="g-col-12 g-col-lg-6">
    <div class="card-panel">
      <h3>Nube de puntos</h3>
      <div class="card-sub" id="scatter_caption"></div>
      <div class="plot" id="scatter_plot"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="g-col-12 g-col-lg-6">
    <div class="card-panel">
      <div id="results"></div>
      <h3>Varianza compartida</h3>
      <div class="venn-caption" id="venn_caption"></div>
      <div class="plot" id="venn_plot"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  const N_MIN = 4, N_MAX = 1000, ALPHA = 0.05, R_MAX = 0.99;
  const BLUE = "#2f6fd0", ORANGE = "#d9822b", GREEN = "#1a7f4b", RED = "#cf222e",
        LINE = "#c0392b", GRID = "#e6e9ed";

  const CASES = {
    A: { r: 0.51, n: 6 },
    B: { r: 0.51, n: 30 },
    C: { r: 0.10, n: 100 },
    D: { r: 0.80, n: 5 }
  };

  const num = (x, digits = 2) => {
    const s = x.toFixed(digits);
    return (/^-0[.,]?0*$/.test(s) ? s.slice(1) : s).replace(".", ",");
  };
  const int = x => String(x).replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ".");

  // ---- Distribución t de Student ----------------------------------------
  function lnGamma(z) {
    const g = [676.5203681218851, -1259.1392167224028, 771.32342877765313,
      -176.61503916999185, 12.507343278686905, -0.13857109526572012,
      9.9843695780195716e-6, 1.5056327351493116e-7];
    if (z < 0.5) return Math.log(Math.PI / Math.sin(Math.PI * z)) - lnGamma(1 - z);
    z -= 1;
    let a = 0.99999999999980993;
    const t = z + 7.5;
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) a += g[i] / (z + i + 1);
    return 0.5 * Math.log(2 * Math.PI) + (z + 0.5) * Math.log(t) - t + Math.log(a);
  }

  // Fracción continua de la beta incompleta (Numerical Recipes)
  function betacf(x, a, b) {
    const FPMIN = 1e-300;
    let qab = a + b, qap = a + 1, qam = a - 1, c = 1, d = 1 - qab * x / qap;
    if (Math.abs(d) < FPMIN) d = FPMIN;
    d = 1 / d;
    let h = d;
    for (let m = 1; m <= 300; m++) {
      const m2 = 2 * m;
      let aa = m * (b - m) * x / ((qam + m2) * (a + m2));
      d = 1 + aa * d; if (Math.abs(d) < FPMIN) d = FPMIN;
      c = 1 + aa / c; if (Math.abs(c) < FPMIN) c = FPMIN;
      d = 1 / d; h *= d * c;
      aa = -(a + m) * (qab + m) * x / ((a + m2) * (qap + m2));
      d = 1 + aa * d; if (Math.abs(d) < FPMIN) d = FPMIN;
      c = 1 + aa / c; if (Math.abs(c) < FPMIN) c = FPMIN;
      d = 1 / d;
      const del = d * c;
      h *= del;
      if (Math.abs(del - 1) < 1e-14) break;
    }
    return h;
  }

  // Beta incompleta regularizada I_x(a, b)
  function ibeta(x, a, b) {
    if (x <= 0) return 0;
    if (x >= 1) return 1;
    const bt = Math.exp(lnGamma(a + b) - lnGamma(a) - lnGamma(b) +
                        a * Math.log(x) + b * Math.log(1 - x));
    return x < (a + 1) / (a + b + 2) ? bt * betacf(x, a, b) / a
                                     : 1 - bt * betacf(1 - x, b, a) / b;
  }

  // P(|T| >= |t|) con df grados de libertad
  const pTwoTailed = (t, df) => ibeta(df / (df + t * t), df / 2, 0.5);

  // Cuantil 1 - alpha/2 por bisección
  function tCrit(df, alpha = ALPHA) {
    let lo = 0, hi = 1000;
    for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
      const mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
      if (pTwoTailed(mid, df) > alpha) lo = mid; else hi = mid;
    }
    return (lo + hi) / 2;
  }

  const tStat = (r, n) => r * Math.sqrt((n - 2) / (1 - r * r));

  function cohenLabel(r) {
    const a = Math.abs(r);
    if (a < 0.1) return "inferior a pequeña";
    if (a < 0.3) return "pequeña";
    if (a < 0.5) return "mediana";
    return "grande";
  }

  // ---- Datos simulados --------------------------------------------------
  function mulberry32(seed) {
    return function () {
      seed |= 0; seed = seed + 0x6D2B79F5 | 0;
      let t = Math.imul(seed ^ seed >>> 15, 1 | seed);
      t = t + Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 7, 61 | t) ^ t;
      return ((t ^ t >>> 14) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };
  }
  function rnorm(n, rand) {
    const out = [];
    while (out.length < n) {
      const u = 1 - rand(), v = rand();
      const m = Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(u));
      out.push(m * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * v), m * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * v));
    }
    return out.slice(0, n);
  }
  const mean = a => a.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / a.length;
  function scale(a) {
    const m = mean(a);
    const sd = Math.sqrt(a.reduce((s, v) => s + (v - m) ** 2, 0) / (a.length - 1));
    return a.map(v => (v - m) / sd);
  }

  // Datos en puntaje z cuya correlación muestral es exactamente r
  function exactCorData(r, n, seed) {
    const rand = mulberry32(seed * 7919 + 17);
    const x = scale(rnorm(n, rand));
    const z = rnorm(n, rand);
    // Residuos de z ~ x (x ya está centrado y con sd 1)
    const zm = mean(z);
    const b = x.reduce((s, xi, i) => s + xi * (z[i] - zm), 0) / (n - 1);
    const e = scale(z.map((zi, i) => zi - zm - b * x[i]));
    const k = Math.sqrt(1 - r * r);
    return x.map((xi, i) => [xi, r * xi + k * e[i]]);
  }

  // Distancia entre centros de dos círculos de radio 1 cuya intersección
  // cubre una proporción r^2 del área de cada círculo
  function vennDistance(r) {
    const target = r * r * Math.PI;
    if (target >= Math.PI - 1e-9) return 0;
    if (target <= 1e-9) return 2;
    const lens = d => 2 * Math.acos(d / 2) - (d / 2) * Math.sqrt(4 - d * d);
    let lo = 0, hi = 2;
    for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
      const mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
      if (lens(mid) > target) lo = mid; else hi = mid;
    }
    return (lo + hi) / 2;
  }

  // ---- Estado y controles -----------------------------------------------
  const state = { r: 0.51, n: 30, seed: 1 };
  const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
  const clampR = x => Math.round(Math.max(Math.min(x, R_MAX), -R_MAX) * 100) / 100;
  const clampN = x => Math.max(Math.min(Math.round(x), N_MAX), N_MIN);

  function set(r, n) {
    if (r !== undefined) state.r = clampR(r);
    if (n !== undefined) state.n = clampN(n);
    $("r_slider").value = state.r; $("r_num").value = state.r;
    $("n_slider").value = state.n; $("n_num").value = state.n;
    render();
  }

  $("r_slider").addEventListener("input", e => set(+e.target.value));
  $("n_slider").addEventListener("input", e => set(undefined, +e.target.value));
  $("r_num").addEventListener("change", e => {
    const v = parseFloat(String(e.target.value).replace(",", "."));
    isNaN(v) ? set() : set(v);
  });
  $("n_num").addEventListener("change", e => {
    const v = parseFloat(e.target.value);
    isNaN(v) ? set() : set(undefined, v);
  });
  $("resample").addEventListener("click", () => { state.seed++; render(); });

  Object.entries(CASES).forEach(([id, cs]) => {
    const b = document.createElement("button");
    b.type = "button";
    b.className = "btn btn-case btn-sm";
    b.innerHTML = `<b>${id}</b> r = ${num(cs.r)}, n = ${int(cs.n)}`;
    b.addEventListener("click", () => set(cs.r, cs.n));
    $("cases").appendChild(b);
  });

  // ---- Gráficos ---------------------------------------------------------
  const SVG_NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  function el(tag, attrs, text) {
    const e = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, tag);
    for (const k in attrs) e.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]);
    if (text !== undefined) e.textContent = text;
    return e;
  }

  function drawScatter(data, r) {
    const W = 500, H = 470, ml = 44, mr = 12, mt = 10, mb = 44;
    const L = 3.4;
    const sx = v => ml + (v + L) / (2 * L) * (W - ml - mr);
    const sy = v => mt + (L - v) / (2 * L) * (H - mt - mb);
    const svg = el("svg", { viewBox: `0 0 ${W} ${H}`, role: "img",
      "aria-label": `Nube de puntos con ${data.length} casos y r = ${num(r)}` });

    for (let v = -3; v <= 3; v++) {
      svg.appendChild(el("line", { x1: sx(v), x2: sx(v), y1: sy(L), y2: sy(-L), stroke: GRID }));
      svg.appendChild(el("line", { x1: sx(-L), x2: sx(L), y1: sy(v), y2: sy(v), stroke: GRID }));
      svg.appendChild(el("text", { x: sx(v), y: H - mb + 18, "text-anchor": "middle", class: "tick" }, v));
      svg.appendChild(el("text", { x: ml - 8, y: sy(v) + 4, "text-anchor": "end", class: "tick" }, v));
    }
    svg.appendChild(el("text", { x: (sx(-L) + sx(L)) / 2, y: H - 6, "text-anchor": "middle",
      class: "axis-title", fill: BLUE }, "x"));
    svg.appendChild(el("text", { x: 10, y: (sy(-L) + sy(L)) / 2 + 5, "text-anchor": "middle",
      class: "axis-title", fill: ORANGE }, "y"));

    const n = data.length;
    const rad = n > 300 ? 1.6 : n > 50 ? 3 : 4.5;
    const op = n > 300 ? 0.55 : 0.8;
    const g = el("g", { fill: BLUE, "fill-opacity": op });
    data.forEach(([x, y]) => {
      if (Math.abs(x) <= L && Math.abs(y) <= L)
        g.appendChild(el("circle", { cx: sx(x), cy: sy(y), r: rad }));
    });
    svg.appendChild(g);

    // Recta y = r·x recortada al área visible
    const xEnd = Math.min(L, L / Math.max(Math.abs(r), 1e-9));
    svg.appendChild(el("line", { x1: sx(-xEnd), y1: sy(-r * xEnd), x2: sx(xEnd), y2: sy(r * xEnd),
      stroke: LINE, "stroke-width": 2.2 }));

    $("scatter_plot").replaceChildren(svg);
  }

  function drawVenn(r) {
    const d = vennDistance(r);
    const x0 = d / 2 - 2.05, w = 4.1, h = 2.1;
    const svg = el("svg", { viewBox: `${x0} -1.05 ${w} ${h}`, role: "img",
      "aria-label": `Diagrama de Venn: X e Y comparten ${num(100 * r * r, 1)} % de varianza` });
    svg.appendChild(el("circle", { cx: 0, cy: 0, r: 1, fill: BLUE, "fill-opacity": 0.35,
      stroke: BLUE, "stroke-width": 0.02 }));
    svg.appendChild(el("circle", { cx: d, cy: 0, r: 1, fill: ORANGE, "fill-opacity": 0.35,
      stroke: ORANGE, "stroke-width": 0.02 }));
    const lbl = { "font-size": 0.22, "font-weight": 700, "text-anchor": "middle", "dominant-baseline": "central" };
    svg.appendChild(el("text", { ...lbl, x: -0.55, y: 0, fill: BLUE }, "X"));
    svg.appendChild(el("text", { ...lbl, x: d + 0.55, y: 0, fill: ORANGE }, "Y"));
    $("venn_plot").replaceChildren(svg);
  }

  // ---- Resultados -------------------------------------------------------
  function render() {
    const { r, n, seed } = state;
    const df = n - 2, t = tStat(r, n), tc = tCrit(df);
    const p = pTwoTailed(t, df), sig = Math.abs(t) >= tc;

    $("scatter_caption").textContent =
      `Cada punto es un caso (n = ${int(n)}). Variables en puntaje z; la recta tiene pendiente r.`;
    drawScatter(exactCorData(r, n, seed), r);

    const col = sig ? GREEN : RED;
    const explanation = sig
      ? `Como |t| = ${num(Math.abs(t))} es mayor que el t crítico (${num(tc)}), se rechaza H₀: hay evidencia para afirmar que la correlación en la población es distinta de cero.`
      : `Como |t| = ${num(Math.abs(t))} es menor que el t crítico (${num(tc)}), no se rechaza H₀: no hay evidencia suficiente para afirmar que la correlación en la población sea distinta de cero.`;
    const pTxt = p < 0.001 ? "< 0,001" : num(p, 3);

    $("results").innerHTML = `
      <div class="verdict" style="color:${col};border-color:${col};">${sig ? "Significativa" : "No significativa"}</div>
      <table class="stats-table">
        <tr><td>Magnitud (Cohen)</td><td>r = ${num(r)}, ${cohenLabel(r)}</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Estadístico t</td><td>${num(t)}</td></tr>
        <tr><td>t crítico (α = ${num(ALPHA)}, dos colas)</td><td>± ${num(tc)}</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Grados de libertad</td><td>${int(df)} (n − 2)</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Valor p</td><td>${pTxt}</td></tr>
      </table>
      <p class="explanation">${explanation}</p>`;

    $("venn_caption").textContent =
      `R² = r² = ${num(100 * r * r, 1)} % de la varianza de Y está asociada a X. Este valor no cambia con n.`;
    drawVenn(r);
  }

  render();
})();
</script>
```


::: {.callout-important}

El coeficiente de correlación y el valor t deben interpretarse en conjunto.

Un coeficiente grande puede ser no significativo si la muestra es pequeña; Un coeficiente pequeño puede ser significativo si la muestra es lo suficientemente grande

Rechazar la hipótesis nula **no dice nada sobre la cantidad de varianza que las dos variables comparten**

:::
